profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Snowflake
profile.summary:
With over 6 years in leadership roles, my expertise in AI, serverless architectures, and machine learning systems has been pivotal in driving innovation at Lang.ai. As the former Head of Engineering, my mission was to foster a culture of collaboration and efficiency, aligning with the company's commitment to cutting-edge AI solutions. My approach has consistently been to leverage diverse perspectives to push the boundaries of what's possible in technology, ensuring that our team's work resonates with our values and objectives.

At Lang.ai, I spearheaded the development of a new generative AI product vertical, enhancing customer interaction through natural language queries. This involved creating a robust RAG framework and a mature evaluation pipeline that emphasized reliability. My background in ML experimentation pipelines at Amazon and my patent in offline simulation platforms underscore my ability to innovate and simplify complex processes. The shift to serverless I championed not only reduced costs significantly but also exemplified my commitment to agile and scalable engineering solutions.

positions.title: Personal goal pursuit
positions.description: Taking a career pause, spending time with family in Spain, chasing personal passions and envisioning my next professional adventure.

positions.title: Head Of Engineering
positions.description:
Led a multi-disciplinary team of front and back developers, data scientists and product owners.
• Introduced structure, process, and cultural changes iteratively. Seamless collaboration between data scientists and product-minded engineers.
• Shifted mentality and operations to CD/CI and observability.
• Boosted productivity, changes released in hours instead of days.

Built a new generative AI product vertical where customers can query their data using natural language. Working directly with select customers releasing prototypes in days.
• Custom RAG framework relying on a variety of LLMs.
• Mature evaluation pipeline for reliable iteration.
• Spearheaded a company wide shift to server-less. Significantly cutting costs and accelerate pace of change.


Authored a scalable and flexible document processing pipeline framework.
• Custom data transformations can be configured on the fly in minutes by non-technical users instead of expensive and slow code changes requiring deployments.
• Brand new third party integrations added in days instead of weeks.

Contributed to all layers of the stack, front, back, data science, infrastructure.
• React, Typescript, Go, Python, Terraform, GQL, GRPC, Kubernetes, AWS serverless, Elastic Search, PostgresSQL.

positions.title: Sr Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Tech owner of the ML experimentation pipeline for the offer selection algorithm of Amazon.com.
• Worked closely with data scientists to invent and simplify. I authored a new pipeline paradigm that increased the amount of experiments performed by the organization worldwide by 10X.
• Delivered a self-serve internal webpage that allowed simulation, scheduling, evaluation and release of experiments facing millions of Amazon website customers. Serverless, Python, Typescript, React.
• Authored an offline simulation platform using replayed traffic that saved $ millions and allowed the team to quickly simulate scenarios in hours instead of weeks. See patent.

Led and coached a team of 5 engineers, mentored others across the organization, helping them grow and getting promoted.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Tech lead of TIER1 team serving 10+ million transactions per day. Went from 10 to 50+ tech members, actively involved in hiring and training.

Authored an innovative plugin architecture that allowed the entire organization to scale.
• Instead of requiring our team to manually review and approve changes, external teams were able to onboard and deploy code on their own.
• Ecosystem grew from 5 to 30+ teams integrated into our realtime TIER1 pricing algorithm.
• Owned end to end, design reviews, reaching consensus, delivering through others, staged deployment, observability and operations.
• This approach became a model adopted by other organizations facing similar challenges.

Played a pivotal role in the successful migration to location aware pricing.
• Identified and drove resolution of vertical bottlenecks involving 5 different teams.
• Single handedly came up with a caching solution that lowered 10% cpu time, resulting in $3+ million in anual savings.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Technical lead on a software team of 5 developers, Agile methodologies
• Involved in all development stages, direct contact with clients on requirement analysis and release stages
• Computer Vision quality control solutions. C#, WPF, OpenCV, SQL
• Implemented highly efficient computer vision algorithms. Shadow profile analysis, Barcode reading, Ultra Violet marks detection...
• Wrote a low level network configuration tool for GigE industrial cameras
• Built interactive UI controls displaying thousands of real time data points

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Emergency Center Radio Control and Communications, PMR and TETRA

• Developed an efficient TETRA Communications Driver able to Monitor and Dispatch thousands of terminals simultaneously. Agile development, Multithreading, .NET
• Designed and programmed UI based applications in VB.NET. Hundreds of db access and network calls per second. Emergency Center operator and dispatcher to operate communications and radio monitoring
• Implemented a Microsoft SQL relational database responsible for all the radio communications data. Modeling and version control through PowerDesigner
• Managed the integration of radio infrastructures employed by security forces, military and emergency services. Peruvian National Police emergency center in Lima, serving millions of civilians

SCADA Design and Development

• Led the development of a SCADA for a modern recycle plant serving 650.000 people. Complex automatization algorithms for ventilation and hydraulic subsystems. NI Labview, PLC programming
• Participated in the automatization and control of a state of the art tunnel. Integrated critical security subsystems. C# and VB custom drivers for AID thermal cameras and SOS posts among others
• Co-developed a Modbus TCP server to enable SCADA remote control, thousands of R/W variables

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Implemented a complex Java simulator to explore an innovative distributed scheduling approach using job stealing. Provided evidence of being a scalable method to achieve load balance at Exaescales
• Under the guidance of Dr. Ioan Raicu, in the framework of a NSF CAREER Award. "Avoiding Achilles' Heel in Exascale Computing with Distributed File Systems"

honors.title: Vodafone Foundation grant
honors.description: Awarded to the best UPM academic records to carry out superior studies in North America

honors.title: Regional Paddle Tennis Tournaments. 2011-2013
honors.description: Champion of 5 different Paddle Tennis Tournaments

projects.title: Centralized and Decentralized Job Scheduling Simulation at Exaescales
projects.description:
Developed a scalable light-weight event simulator to schedule real Many Task Computing (MTC) workloads. MTC is a new viable distributed paradigm for extreme-scale supercomputing

Explored innovative distributed scheduling approach using Work Stealing obtaining surprising results. Provided evidence of being a scalable method to achieve load balance at Exaescales

The project has evolved and it is now called "SIMulator for MAny-TasK computing execution faBRIc at eXaescale" (SimMatrix)

patents.title: Offline Evaluation of Machine Learning Models with Noise Reduction
System for Reducing Computations Performed for Iterative Requests
